Bhuvneshwar Kumar's Cricket Future Dominates Indian Sports News

Reports indicate that Indian cricketer Bhuvneshwar Kumar's future in international cricket is a subject of discussion, with speculation about potential replacements and his retirement. One outlet questioned whether Bhuvneshwar Kumar would be called upon to replace Arshdeep Singh due to an injury, while another reported that Bhuvneshwar Kumar is set to retire from international cricket.
